data.name: Binding Pattern
data.description: You can cause creatures struck with your disrupt pattern ability to become entangled for %1 rounds, although the disrupt pattern damage is minimized.  Entangled creatures can attempt to break free as a move action, making a Strength or Escape Artist check.  The DC for this check is %2.|BindingPatternDuration|BindingPatternDC
